portwatch_arcgis_items.title: Daily_Ports_Data
portwatch_arcgis_items.snippet: These estimates are based on satellite-captured signals on 90 thousands ships worldwide, harnessing the power of big data analytics. The methodology is described in the paper below.

portwatch_arcgis_items.title: Daily_Chokepoints_Data
portwatch_arcgis_items.snippet: Daily transit calls and estimates of transit trade volumes (in metric tons) for 28 chokepoints around the world.
